selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline: initial insecure state of /srv/inventory before repair
selected_evidence.summary: Directory/files owned by root:root with 755/644 perms; inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group did not exist

selected_evidence.requirement: Existing content captured before modification (to prove preservation)
selected_evidence.summary: sha256sum and cat of config.json and records.csv recorded pre-change

selected_evidence.requirement: Create inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group
selected_evidence.summary: groupadd inventory-readers and useradd inventorysvc succeeded; id/getent confirm creation

selected_evidence.requirement: Ownership set to inventorysvc, group inventory-readers, others excluded (750/640)
selected_evidence.summary: chown/chmod applied recursively; stat confirms inventorysvc:inventory-readers 750 on dirs, 640 on files
sha256sum hashes identical before and after the ownership/permission change

selected_evidence.requirement: Functional proof: readers group can read, other users cannot
selected_evidence.summary: sudo -u reader_check (member of inventory-readers) successfully read config.json; sudo -u other_check was denied read and directory listing

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart - healthy baseline before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 29011044-5356-46eb-ba9c-1470170355a7 and confirmed /srv/inventory permissions healthy pre-restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart - restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: Backgrounded delayed reboot command acknowledged (pid returned) before the node disconnected

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart - proof of changed boot identity (actual restart, not just downtime)
selected_evidence.summary: Connection reset/timeout observed during reboot, then node returned with new boot_id 367d272b-ec22-47b6-b545-762f0c660364 and uptime of ~3s, proving a fresh boot distinct from baseline

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart - post-restart recovery of required state (permissions, ownership, data, accounts)
selected_evidence.summary: After restart: ownership/permissions unchanged (inventorysvc:inventory-readers, 750/640), file content hashes identical to baseline, and inventorysvc/inventory-readers accounts still present
